title: Cheese Burst Masala Dosa 🧀🔥 crispy South Indian #shorts

segments.moment_description: Walking into the outdoor village kitchen
Preparing the dosa batter and potato masala
Spreading the dosa and layering cheese on the tawa
The cheese-burst dosa melting and crisping
Serving the masala dosa on a banana leaf
Sharing and eating the crispy cheese masala dosa

description:
Cheese Burst Masala Dosa 🧀🔥 — a crispy golden dosa loaded with molten cheese and spiced potato masala, folded over for the ultimate cheese pull. South Indian classic, next-level.

Classic masala dosa or cheese burst — which side are you on? 👇 Comment!

🌿 Made with fermented dosa batter, spiced potato masala, mustard-curry-leaf tempering and a generous layer of melting cheese, served with chutney and sambar.

Did you know? A great dosa gets its crackly crispness from a well-fermented rice-and-urad dal batter spread thin on a screaming-hot tawa — the cheese is the modern twist.
